examples.en: Maybe you can water the vegetable garden or the houseplants.
examples.zh: 也许你可以给菜园或室内植物浇水。

examples.en: In another, employees were shown to be 15% more productive when their workplaces were decorated with houseplants.
examples.zh: 另一项研究显示，工作场所内有绿植装饰的话，员工的工作效率能提高15%。

examples.en: Overwatering is the no. 1 killer of houseplants.
examples.zh: 过量浇水是杀死室内盆栽的头号杀手。
